messages:
maria.seo: quick intake question — red team requested a write-capable KMS principal for key-wrapping tests in staging. before we say yes, need clarity on exact actions, audit capture, and RBAC bounds. proposing retest window: Wed Mar 11 09:00-13:00 PT. who can confirm constraints?

tom.kim: do not give CreateKey/ScheduleKeyDeletion. we can provide limited crypto ops. prefer ephemeral role w/ explicit allowed actions: kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:ReEncrypt. 4h max. also need CloudTrail + S3 delivery enabled for the window.

rachel.sre: +1 on 4h. we'll turn on CloudTrail management & data events for KMS and S3 and ship to secured bucket. retention: 90 days short-term, 365 archived. enable CloudWatch Logs export for real-time review.

maria.seo: sample IAM/KMS policy? i'll attach to the intake form so pen-test vendor signs off on constraints.

tom.kim: paste below (for intake):
```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": [
    "kms:Encrypt",
    "kms:Decrypt",
    "kms:GenerateDataKey",
    "kms:ReEncrypt*"
  ],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/EXAMPLE-KEY-ID",
  "Condition": {
    "DateLessThan": {"aws:CurrentTime": "2026-03-11T13:00:00Z"}
  }
}
```

dave.ops: also add deny for kms:CreateGrant unless from our grant-operator role. and block CreateKey/ScheduleKeyDeletion at org SCP level for that role. i'll prepare the SCP patch.

maria.seo: audit logging questions: we need request_id correlation (x-request-id) surfaced for all wrapper calls so we can map to CloudTrail events. can the test harness include that header?

rachel.sre: yes, we can require the harness to send x-request-id. we'll add middleware to trace it through. set sampling to 100% for the 4h window.

tom.kim: what about KMS access method? advise: use AssumeRole to access a short-lived principal, not long-lived keys. federation via OIDC or SAML is fine. no direct IAM user creds.

maria.seo: vendor asked for S3 write to upload artifacts from tests. we can provide a pre-signed upload bucket with server-side encryption using the same staging KMS key, but limit PutObject to the vendor principal and enable object lock? thoughts?

dave.ops: pre-signed uploads are fine. we'll enable PutObject with kms:EncryptionContext enforcement and S3 object lock retention 30d to preserve evidence. also enable bucket-level logging.

sec-ops-bot: artifact created: s3://redwood-pt-artifacts/2071234567/ (access logs enabled)

maria.seo: RBAC matrix: attaching mapping of red-team roles -> infra roles. will upload to /security/pt-intake/matrices. need signoff from @legal-gate for data handling constraints.

legal-gate: quick note — vendor NDA covers access to staging PII-free datasets only. confirm vendor will not use production secrets. we need a signed attestation before hands-on.

tom.kim: also: add a smoke-test checklist post-role-provisioning: 1) verify assume-role returns expected policies 2) attempt blocked ops (CreateKey/Delete) and confirm deny 3) confirm CloudTrail event shows aws:userid and x-request-id.

rachel.sre: i'll own smoke tests. please add me to the intake ticket so i can flip CloudTrail and sampling.

maria.seo: i've updated the intake ticket with policy snippets, RBAC matrix, and retest window. requesting approvals: @tom.kim, @rachel.sre, @dave.ops, @legal-gate. planning a 30m pre-retest sync Monday (Mar 9) to walk steps.

dave.ops: i'll create the ephemeral role and the SCP change in a draft PR and tag reviewers. will include runbook: snapshot IAM state, enable logs, lock destructive APIs, verify S3 bucket settings, post-run rollback steps.

tom.kim: one more ask — capture API gateway logs with request_id to link app layer calls to KMS CloudTrail. rachel can you enable dev trace connector?

rachel.sre: yes, enabling trace connector and forwarding to our sec-trace index. will set retention & make a short query template for triage.

maria.seo: perfect. last item: retest evidence handoff — we'll require vendor to upload a CSV of executed test cases and generated request_ids to s3://redwood-pt-artifacts/2071234567/; Sec team will pull CloudTrail slices for validation.

sec-ops-bot: task created: PT_RETEST_PREP_2071234567 assigned to dave.ops (due 2026-03-08)

maria.seo: timeline locked pending approvals. thanks all — i'll ping again once legal signs attestation. :thumbsup:
